Latest QA Defect Summary : 🐞

Item Details
Defect Title Street View page does not reload / redirect upon logout (Auth State Defect)
Issue Target #1750
Environment https://dev.panorra.com
Defect Classification Routing & Session State Management / White Box Defect
Severity High (Unauthorized route persistence)
Status BUG (Needs developer fix)
Bug Video Evidence
2026-09-10.11-40-55.mp4

Defect Description & Technical Analysis for Developer (Full English):

  1. Observed Behavior: When a user clicks Log Out while on the Street View authoring page (/street-view), the page is not reloaded or redirected to a public page (/home or /explore). The session is demoted to viewer/guest, but the user remains stuck on the private Street View authoring interface without a page reload or state reset.
  2. Root Cause Analysis:
    • src/app/layout/layout.routes.ts: Route path: 'street-view' lacks canActivate: [authGuard].
    • src/app/pages/street-view/street-view.component.ts: Component does not check sessionStore.isLoggedIn() to trigger a defensive redirect when an unauthenticated/guest session is detected.
  3. Recommendation:
    • Attach canActivate: [authGuard] to the 'street-view' route in layout.routes.ts.
    • Ensure the logout routine (layoutService.logOut('/home')) navigates back to the landing page.
2026-09-10.11-40-55.mp4

Conclusion : 🐞

Failed: After conducting testing on the Street View feature, we found a bug regarding logout handling and routing that requires developer attention.
